source_metadata.point_source_file_context: Individual industrial and commercial sources with known grid references; source groups include PI/WEI/SPRI/PIV/E-PRTR, UK ETS, local authority control and modelled sources.
source_metadata.capability_access_note: Nine declared GetCapabilities links were attempted: one large-point-source service and eight local-authority GHG services. The web client returned cache miss or 400-style safe-open failures; no capabilities XML bytes were observed.
source_metadata.raw_asset_hash_note: No WMS capabilities XML or feature response bytes were obtained; no raw asset hash was invented.
source_metadata.row_set_hash_scope: Canonical compact JSON of 280 UK-AIR/NAEI WMS layer and fail-closed evidence rows.

policy.semantic_rule: WMS layer identity, protocol and licence metadata are evidence only. A map image, aggregate layer or point-source label is not an observed annual facility mass row.
policy.result: All 280 rows remain HELD; no WMS value, facility-year emission, business row or parcel binding was written.
